user.title: Connect to SweTrack
user.description: Create an external API key in the SweTrack app or web portal and paste it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect SweTrack
reauth_confirm.description: The connection to SweTrack account **{account}** must be renewed. Enter a new API key for the same account.

error.invalid_auth: The API key is invalid or expired

abort.already_configured: This SweTrack account is already configured
abort.wrong_account: The API key belongs to a different SweTrack account

init.title: SweTrack settings
init.description: Automatic mode adjusts the interval according to the API quota when quota information is available. The fixed interval field is only used in fixed mode.

api_quota_exhausted.title: SweTrack API quota exhausted
api_quota_exhausted.description: Home Assistant cannot retrieve new data for SweTrack account **{account}** because the daily API quota has been exhausted. The integration automatically increases the polling interval and will retry later. This issue is removed when the API responds normally.
